aliases.description: Alternative names useful for entity resolution; aliases do not create separate entities.
retrieval_examples: alias exacto Ody -> aliases contains Ody
aliases.retrieval_guidance: Use deterministic exact matching only when the user explicitly asks for an exact alias. Ordinary name or entity search remains semantic.

birth_date.description: Known date of birth of the person.
retrieval_examples: personas nacidas después de 1990 -> birth_date gt 1990-12-31
personas nacidas en 1990 -> gte 1990-01-01, lt 1991-01-01
birth_date.retrieval_guidance: Person domain date. Serialize as YYYY-MM-DD (for example 1990-12-31). Use half-open ranges for years or months.

created_at.description: Timestamp when Odyssey created the note.
retrieval_examples: ¿Qué escribí ayer sobre n8n? -> created_at day range in the supplied timezone
created_at.retrieval_guidance: Odyssey note-lifecycle creation timestamp: when Odyssey created, wrote, or stored the note. Use for creé, escribí, guardé, or apunté. It is not the domain date described by the note. Serialize as timezone-aware ISO 8601 (for example 2026-08-20T00:00:00+02:00); never emit timezone-less lifecycle datetimes. Prefer half-open ranges: gte start, lt next boundary.

entry_date.description: Date the journal entry refers to.
retrieval_examples: entradas de diario de agosto -> entry_date August range
entradas de diario que escribí ayer -> created_at yesterday range
entry_date.retrieval_guidance: Domain date only for journal_entry: the date the diary entry refers to, not when Odyssey stored it. Serialize as YYYY-MM-DD. Use half-open ranges for years or months. ‘entradas de diario de agosto’ uses entry_date; ‘entradas de diario que escribí ayer’ uses created_at.

relationship_to_user.description: How the person is related to the user.
relationship_to_user.retrieval_guidance: Use deterministic filtering only when the request maps safely to an exact stored relationship value. Never invent relationship values; otherwise keep the wording semantic.

type.description: Canonical note type selected from the type registry.
retrieval_examples: personas y proyectos -> person/project restriction
ideas sobre Odyssey -> no type restriction
decisiones sobre Odyssey -> no type restriction
type.retrieval_guidance: Type is a hard candidate restriction. Use it only when the request explicitly and safely identifies canonical note classes; semantic facets are not types and stay in the semantic query.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the latest Odyssey modification to the note.
retrieval_examples: ¿Qué modifiqué hoy? -> today updated_at range
updated_at.retrieval_guidance: Odyssey note-lifecycle modification timestamp. Use for modifiqué, actualicé, or cambié. Serialize as timezone-aware ISO 8601 (for example 2026-08-20T00:00:00+02:00); never emit timezone-less lifecycle datetimes. Prefer half-open ranges: gte start, lt next boundary.

limitations.direct_link_not_filterable: An exact direct wikilink relation cannot currently be filtered deterministically.
limitations.not_supported: An exact exclusion / NOT condition cannot currently be represented deterministically.
limitations.unsupported_domain_date: The requested non-lifecycle/domain-event date has no canonical deterministic field.
